verdict.rationale: The SDK supports composing multiple agents via handoffs (agent-to-agent delegation) and 'agents as tools', plus a Runner class (run/run_sync/run_streamed) that developers can wrap in their own Python control flow to build loops, branches, or parallel calls. However, there is no evidence of a first-class declarative graph/workflow builder with explicit branching, loop, or parallel-step primitives (unlike graph-orchestration frameworks) — composition here is code-driven rather than a defined workflow graph. Missing for 10: explicit graph/DAG builder API, native loop/branch/parallel step constructs, and independent evidence of complex multi-branch workflows in production.
